name: bench-006-fan-mount-v1
summary: Flat 60mm-fan-to-2020 adapter plate: fan 50mm bolt square (4x M3) + central airflow bore on +Z face, 2x M5 T-nut clearance through the plate to the extrusion slot below, 4mm plate, PLA, prints flat without supports.

dimensions.spec: central open bore so the fan is not occluded
2x M5 clearance (5.2mm), spaced for the 2020 slot
from vertical, printable flat-on-build-plate without support

required_interfaces.must_present: 4x M3 in 50mm square + central airflow bore (>=56mm), +Z face
2x M5 clearance spaced ~20mm for T-nuts, drilled through the plate (-Z face)

hard_constraints: single flat plate (no upright, no shroud, no walls)
printable flat on FDM without supports (overhangs <= 45 deg)
fan bolts and T-nut bolts each keep >= min_wall land to the nearest plate edge
airflow bore keeps >= min_wall to the corner bolts
